strategyBrief.appSummary: A native spreadsheet for Mac and iPad that opens and saves .xlsx files, with 157 functions, charts, pivot tables, sort and filter. No account, no subscription, never connects to the internet. One purchase covers Mac and iPad.
strategyBrief.targetAudience: iPad and Mac owners who get .xlsx files from work, school or clients and want to open, edit and chart them without an Office subscription or an account

competitors.name: Microsoft Excel
competitors.gapToExploit: needs a Microsoft account and a subscription to edit on large iPads

competitors.name: Apple Numbers
competitors.gapToExploit: converts .xlsx to its own format; formulas and layouts change

competitors.name: Google Sheets
competitors.gapToExploit: needs a Google account and the cloud; files leave the device

positioning.corePromise: Open and edit your spreadsheets on iPad and Mac, bought once, with no account
positioning.differentiator: XLSX is the native file format (no import, no export, no conversion); pay once for Mac and iPad, no subscription or account
proofPoints: One purchase covers Mac and iPad
Opens a 20,000-row workbook in 1.4 s on Mac

reviewPhrases: just want to open a spreadsheet
